newsitem.title: UK: Major says "ever-closer" EU not desirable.
newsitem.headline: Major says "ever-closer" EU not desirable.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major said an enlarged European Union must be a partnership of nations rather than a united states of Europe.
"Some of our partners do see the future of Europe as ever-closer political as well as economic integration," he told the Conservative party conference.
"We don't believe this is practical, nor, to be frank, desirable. It's not the Europe we joined and it's not a Europe we can accept."
"Europe must become more flexible and responsive...the only realistic future is as a partnership of nations," he added.
"In our next five years, we will seek new opportunities -- an opportunity owning democracy."
